RHFiles bundles an unmodified FFmpeg command-line executable as a separate
program for optional media conversion.

Bundled build
-------------
FFmpeg 9.0.1 Essentials Build for Windows x64 by Gyan Doshi
Package: ffmpeg-9.0.1-essentials_build.7z
Package SHA-256: 49a73bdf0850092a252ac4641d922f3048d63ed113e196cc65ce1e4f7fb33e85
Binary and build information: https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/
Corresponding FFmpeg revision: https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/commit/bf1b838f2a
FFmpeg source: https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/tree/bf1b838f2a

The bundled build is licensed under GPLv3. Its original LICENSE and README are
included beside RHFiles as FFmpeg-LICENSE.txt and FFmpeg-README.txt. RHFiles
invokes ffmpeg.exe as a separate process and does not link against FFmpeg.

FFmpeg is a trademark of Fabrice Bellard, originator of the FFmpeg project.
